notes.evidence: Source inspection at the pinned revisions; no full inference observation claimed.
notes.representation: One CSV table decoded using the header as field names. Numeric cells may be safely cast to the declared types; the author writes CSV, not JSON objects.
notes.scope: Camera-trap session metadata CSV for active DepthAI tracklets. Full hardware inference remains unverified because no OAK device is attached.
notes.coordinates: x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max are frame-normalized corners after deletterboxing, rounded to four decimals; multiply x by original frame width and y by original frame height for pixels.
notes.confidence: Detector confidence in [0,1], rounded to two decimals; label is the configured display name rather than a numeric class ID.
notes.tracking: Only NEW and TRACKED tracklets are written; LOST and REMOVED have no CSV rows. track_id is a tracker identifier, not a class index.
notes.timestamp: timestamp is datetime.now().isoformat(): local time without a timezone suffix, so it is declared string, not the stricter schema ISO type.
notes.camera: device_id is HOSTNAME; session_id is an incrementing integer. exposure_time is milliseconds rounded to two decimals, iso_sensitivity and lens_position are camera metadata. filename associates the row with its JPEG.
